description: This file is a Makefile used for building Linux kernels within the OpenWrt project, containing variable definitions, build rules, and configuration macros specific to kernel compilation and image creation.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Defines the default procedure to prepare the Linux kernel source, either by downloading, extracting, and patching, or by linking to an external kernel tree based on configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs/PreConfigure
methods.description: Pre-configuration step for setting up initramfs support in the kernel configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Configures kernel settings for initramfs, updating configuration files with appropriate options and compression settings.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes initramfs support from the kernel configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Default configuration procedure for the kernel, including setting kernel config options, copying configs, and generating version information.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Initramfs
methods.description: Configures kernel for initramfs support by invoking the relevant setup macro.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules/Default
methods.description: Builds kernel modules and saves configuration state.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies the built kernel image and related files to the designated build directory, ensuring proper version and debug information.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Builds the Linux kernel image with default parameters.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Initramfs
methods.description: Builds kernel image with embedded initramfs, including optional compression settings and initrd creation.

methods.name: Kernel/Clean/Default
methods.description: Cleans up kernel build artifacts and resets configuration.
